stop_condition_set_in_advance: abandon the pose channel if the detector finds figures in <30% of engravings
decision: continue, and record why the threshold was not applied mechanically
reading: The 120-image sample was unrepresentative -- 56.7% against 28.2% on the full corpus -- which is a reminder that a pilot drawn from the head of a file ordered by identifier is one book, not a sample. But the threshold was protecting against an asymmetry: a detector that reads paintings and not engravings would make the channel a medium detector. The museums rate is 29.3% against the engravings 28.2%, so the detector is evenhanded and merely conservative on art in general. The protection says continue. The real constraint is coverage: a channel present on 28% of pictures can only speak for 28% of queries, and must be evaluated on the subset where both sides of a pair carry a pose.
